title: DiscoveryResult
description: V3.5 fresh-prospect discovery output for one SUB-NICHE x CITY market cell. A legitimate result can be an empty candidates array -- discovery never pads to reach a quota.

independently_owned.description: false or null for an obvious national chain/large corporation/franchise not independently operated -- these must be excluded from candidates, not merely flagged

google_dependency_evidence.description: Why this business's customer acquisition plausibly depends on Google Search/Maps (e.g. emergency/local-intent service category, visible reliance on organic/local-pack traffic) -- never a bare assertion with no basis

source_notes.description: Where/how this business was found (search query, directory, GBP listing, etc.)

excluded_count.description: How many businesses were considered and excluded (chain/franchise/non-commercial/duplicate/weak Google dependency) -- honesty signal that real research happened
